intent_en: Analyze how the share of voters residing in landslide counties changed across the years shown, and determine the direction of the trend.
narration_support: In 1976, roughly 28 % of voters lived in what are called landslide counties. In 2012, that number increased to about 50%. And now, in 2016, 60 % of voters live in landslide counties.
chart_support: Bar chart displaying the percentage of voters in landslide counties for the years 1976, 2012, and 2016, showing a clear upward trend with increasing bar heights.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly describes the growth in the number of voters in landslide counties over time, which is visually confirmed by the rising bars in the chart for the years 1976, 2012, and 2016.
narrative_goal: To illustrate the increasing proportion of voters residing in landslide counties from 1976 to 2016.
current_model_input: Analyze how the share of voters residing in landslide counties changed across the years shown, and determine the direction of the trend.
